description: KiwiRail publishes railway culverts as point features in New Zealand Transverse Mercator. The schema includes material, form, width, depth, height, diameter, barrel count, length and asset identifier. The provider says locations were assembled through a desktop exercise and have not all been field verified. These are railway drainage assets with relevant physical attributes; measured hydraulic performance and condition are not established by the metadata. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing KiwiRail network-risk and freight-disruption layers.
